test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Harming**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Harming **means causing damage or injury to someone or something. (किसी को या किसी चीज़ को क्षति या चोट पहुँचाना)

 
 
• **Example**: *The reckless driver caused a serious accident, harming several pedestrians.*
 
 
 
• The sentence suggests that the action being done is causing harm to someone or something.
